descriptions.zh:
**"** 此接口面向开放API的用户
- 该接口需要全量更新，不支持部分参数更新
- 修改ApiName时需要注意，同一个分组内API不允许重名
- 修改RequestPath时需要注意，同一个分组内Path不允许重复
- 该接口调用的QPS限制为：单用户QPS不超过50
descriptions.en:
This operation is for Open API users.

- This operation supports only full updates.

- API names must be unique within an API group.

- Paths must be unique within an API group.

- The rate limit for this operation is 50 queries per second (QPS) per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-stage-model --stage-alias '生产环境' --stage-model-id sdljflsjflj324xxx --description test --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyStageModel --region cn-hangzhou --StageModelId sdljflsjflj324xxx --Description test --StageAlias '生产环境'
